title: Watch catch-up TV
answer: On a channel where your provider offers catch-up, open the Timeline guide and press Left to browse earlier programmes. Available replays have a gold ↺ mark. OK on a past programme starts the preview; OK again on that programme opens it full screen. Older hours without programme names appear as Catch-up HH:MM blocks and can also be played. How far back you can watch depends on your provider's retention window.
controls: Android · Timeline · ← into the past · OK twice

title: Back to now in the guide
answer: When browsing a different time in the Timeline guide, Back returns the guide to now; the gold Now button does the same. This only moves the guide: a replay keeps playing. Fast-forward does not return to live from the guide. To change playback back to live, open the replay full screen and use its gold LIVE button or the remote's Fast-forward key. Back from full screen returns to the guide while the replay continues.
controls: In the guide: Back or the gold Now button

title: Catch-up not working
answer: If replay channels or past programmes are missing after updating, run Update Content and update your playlists, then Update EPG Now once. Catch-up is available on Android TV, Fire TV and Android phones; Windows support is not available yet. Your provider must offer catch-up for that channel. The provider decides how many days are available; guide data may cover fewer hours, with older hours shown as Catch-up HH:MM blocks. Refreshing cannot add replay support to a channel your provider does not support.
controls: Update Content → update playlists · Settings → Playlists & guide → EPG → Update EPG Now

title: Preview, then full screen
answer: The first OK plays the channel in the preview box; OK again opens it full screen.

title: Search channels
answer: Open Search from the side menu and enter the channel name. Matching channels appear in the Live TV row. Move to a channel and press OK to play it. Search also shows matching movies, TV shows and Media Hub titles in separate rows.
controls: Search (magnifying glass) in the side menu

title: Channel menu
answer: Add to / Remove from Favourites, Hide this channel, Move Up / Down (your own order inside the group or Favourites), Move to group…, Remove from a group, and Record on Android. To reorder Favourites in the list or Timeline guide, hold OK on a channel, choose Move Up / Down, use ↑ / ↓, then OK or Back to finish. Each viewer's order is saved across playlists and takes priority over the default playlist or A-Z order. Clear the guide's search filter before moving a channel.

title: Sort live groups
answer: The filter icon offers Provider order, Name A–Z and Name Z–A. Each playlist stays together; your own groups sort separately. The choice is remembered on this device. Manual Move Up / Down or Move to Top restores the stored order. Favourites channel order stays as you arranged it.

title: Group menu
answer: Add to Favourites, Hide Group, Move Up / Down, Move to Top, and New group… to start your own group.

title: Your group's menu
answer: Move Up / Down, Move to Top, New group…, Delete. Your groups sit under Favourites and History and mix channels from every playlist.
controls: Hold OK on your own group

title: Clear this tab's favourites
answer: Asks first. Works on the Favourites row of TV, Movies and TV Shows.

title: Clear channel history
answer: Asks first.

title: Catch-up playlists
answer: The Catch-up group lists every channel your provider marks with catch-up. OK or → on a playlist hides or shows its channels in this group only (for a provider that marks channels it doesn't really keep). Settings > Interface > Tabs can hide the whole group.

title: Jump to a playlist, or hide its groups here
answer: OK jumps to that playlist's groups. → on a playlist hides or shows all its groups in this tab only (its channels stay in Search and Favourites).

title: Resume the last channel
answer: What the "Hold > to resume" pill means. Works even with the pill turned off in Settings.

title: Refine the existing appearance
answer: Off by default and independent for each profile. Adds glossy panels, brighter reflections, bevelled edges and blur around focused controls. Uses more graphics resources. Keeps the same layout, theme colours, text sizes and remote navigation. Turn it off to restore the original finish.

title: Hide the resume reminder
answer: Turn off Show the "Hold > to resume" reminder. This hides the pill while a channel plays in the background. On Android, holding Right still resumes the last channel.

title: Back to live
answer: While a catch-up replay plays full screen, select the gold LIVE button to return to the channel live. The remote's dedicated Fast-forward key does the same in full screen. It is not a guide shortcut: Back or Now in the guide only moves the guide to the current time and leaves the replay playing.
controls: Android replay · gold LIVE button or remote ⏩ Fast-forward

title: Watch a programme from the start
answer: To restart a programme on a catch-up-capable channel, open the player bar and choose Watch from the start, or press the remote's dedicated Rewind key in full screen. On live TV this starts the programme on now from its beginning. During a replay it restarts the programme at your current playback time. Your provider must offer that part of the programme.
controls: Android · player bar: Watch from the start · remote ⏪ Rewind

title: Pause live TV and resume
answer: You can pause live TV on a channel that supports catch-up, then press Play to resume from where you paused. Short pauses use the existing buffer; after more than 90 seconds VesperTV uses the provider's catch-up feed (timeshift). Availability still depends on the provider's replay window. Use the gold LIVE button in full screen when you want to return to live.
controls: Android catch-up channel · remote ⏯ or player Play/Pause

title: Seek and change replay programmes
answer: The catch-up player shows a CATCH-UP tag, programme progress and how far behind live you are. Use the time bar to seek within the programme, or the previous / next programme buttons when listings are available. Next returns to live if there is no later programme to replay. At the end of the programme you picked, playback pauses so the next one doesn't start on its own: press Play to carry on, or turn on Settings → Playback → Catch-up → Keep playing after the programme. A paused live channel resuming through catch-up keeps going until it catches up to live.
controls: Android replay · player bar: previous / restart / next · ↑ to the time bar

title: Side panel
answer: Last channels, My Teams and Live now, without leaving the video. OK on one switches to it; Back closes the panel. Phone: swipe right to open, swipe left to close.

title: Pull stats
answer: The game's box score and stats open beside the panel, over the video.
controls: Hold OK on a game in the side panel

title: Info card
answer: What's on now and next, with a gold tag naming the channel's playlist. With Settings › Playback › Data pool on, a second card shows resolution, fps, codecs and bitrate.

title: Channel schedule
answer: With the info card up, Up highlights Channel schedule and OK opens the channel's programmes on the left, on the show playing. OK on a past show with catch-up watches it from the start; OK on the show on now goes back to live. Back closes it.

title: Data pool
answer: With Settings › Playback › Data pool on, OK opens the stream details card: resolution, frame rate, codecs, measured bitrate, buffer and playback state.

title: Player bar
answer: Opens the bar with Play/Pause already selected: audio track, subtitles, Multiview and more are on the same row.

title: Next / previous channel
answer: Zaps through the list you opened the channel from. Page Up / Page Down do the same.

title: Scrub the time bar
answer: On a movie or episode, Up from the buttons selects the time bar. Hold Left or Right: the marker jumps further the longer you hold (10 s up to 5 min) and shows the target time. Let go and it seeks there; OK seeks at once. Down returns to the buttons. Smaller subtitles: Subtitles › Subtitle size › Extra small.

title: Play / Pause
answer: The remote's own Play/Pause key works anywhere in the player.

title: Leave full screen
answer: With the side panel open, Back closes the panel first.

title: Hide profiles on Home
answer: Turn this on to remove the profiles row from Home. It is off by default and applies to the active profile. You can still manage profiles in Settings.

title: Favourite on / off
answer: A star appears on the poster, and the title joins Favourites.

title: Mark watched / unwatched
answer: A watched episode starts over from the beginning. Synced to Trakt / Simkl when signed in.
controls: Hold OK on a season chip to mark the whole season watched / unwatched; on an episode

title: Expand catalog
answer: The whole group as a grid, with sorting (and TMDB release-date sorting if you added a TMDB key).

title: Manage source cards
answer: Open from Settings › Media Hub › Media Hub sources, or Sources in the Media Hub tab. Add a source, From phone, Stremio import, Jellyfin / Emby and Trakt / Simkl are at the top. Playback sources provide video; Catalogs & lists, including Cinemeta, provide titles that play through those sources. Left/Right moves between cards; Up/Down moves through their controls and grid rows, scrolling as needed. OK on Enabled switches a source on or off; hold OK there to remove it. View source URL reveals the saved link and offers Copy URL. Show under Other puts an add-on behind the Other genre filter; refresh Media Hub after changing it.

title: Stream sources
answer: Slide out the other files for this movie or episode, including provider, advertised format and size when available. Up/Down browses, OK switches at the current position and saves the selected source for resume; Left or Back closes.

title: Floating bar
answer: Search, a button for each row, Genre and Newest. Genre › Other holds add-on catalogs that aren't plain movies or series. Newest shows only this year's releases (from a source's release-year catalog, such as the New row); pick a genre as well to see the new releases in that genre. Sources whose titles carry no genre information drop out while a genre is picked. After adding a TMDB catalog to an add-on, press Refresh so Newest can use it.

title: Favourite on / off
answer: On Recently watched, hold removes the title from that row instead.

title: Row menu
answer: Expand catalog (the whole row as a grid) or Go to row.
controls: Hold OK on a row's bar button

title: Your source finished fetching it
answer: If a title played a short "being downloaded" video, press Back and carry on. The poster gets a Ready tag when the full file is there. Optional: add your debrid key in Settings › Media Hub › Debrid accounts for an exact check.

title: Mark watched / unwatched
answer: Same as provider shows.
controls: Hold OK on a season chip to mark the whole season watched / unwatched; on an episode

title: Choose the best quality copy
answer: On by default, per profile. Offers a matched 4K game source first, even from a different broadcaster; your explicit channel pick always wins. Turn it off to use the usual match order.

title: Select it
answer: Shows the game's details in the hero at the top.

title: Watch in the hero
answer: Plays the game's channel in the small player at the top. OK on the playing game goes full screen; Back stops it.

title: Game menu
answer: Play here, choose another channel, Record until the show ends / until I stop it (Android).

title: Reorder leagues
answer: Move the chip with ← →, then OK to drop it.
controls: Hold OK on a league chip

title: Your leagues
answer: A menu of all your leagues with how many games each has on the day shown and how many are live. Pick one to see only that league.

title: Pick its channel
answer: NFL Sundays.
controls: Hold OK on the RedZone pill

title: Live games list
answer: Every live game in one list. OK = stats pop-up, Hold OK = channel menu, ⏯ = play full screen.

title: Follow it (My Teams)
answer: Followed teams' games come first, with a star.
controls: OK on a team in Standings

title: Remind me
answer: Choose Remind me to open the timing menu: 15 minutes, 1 hour, 1 day or 1 week before, plus a reminder at game time. You can also choose At game time only. Passed advance times are unavailable. Popups appear above any screen or stream while VesperTV is open. You do not need to follow either team. For teams in My Teams, choose Remind me for every game to enable automatic reminders for that team, or Stop team reminders to disable them. Hold again to Cancel reminder for one game, or choose Reminder timing to change its advance time. Automatic team reminders keep the 15-minute default unless you override an individual game. A faded team logo appears behind the popup text. Reminders belong to the current viewer on this device.
controls: Hold OK on any upcoming Sports Trak game

title: Score alerts for one match
answer: Choose Set goals alert for this match to get the existing top-left score popup when either team scores, even if neither team is in My Teams. Remove goals alert for this match stops it. This per-game choice works independently of the My Teams Goals alert switch. Hide scores still pauses all score alerts. Choices belong to this profile and device; alerts follow the sports feed while VesperTV is open.
controls: Hold OK on an upcoming or live team game

title: Score alerts for My Teams
answer: Off by default. Enable it for a top-left popup when any followed team scores, above any screen or stream while VesperTV is open. The card shows the team and league logos and the current score. Game reminders stay top-right; on a phone the cards stack. Alerts follow the sports feed's update speed, pause with Hide scores or when the app is in the background, and do not replay old scores on launch or profile changes.

title: Schedule, Follow or Unfollow
answer: Schedule opens the team's season as a month calendar: each game day shows the opponent's logo and the time or result. Football (soccer) includes the cups (FA Cup, Carabao Cup, Champions League…), marked with the cup's logo. Arrows move a day or a week, CH+/CH- change month. OK shows the stats of a finished game, watches a live one or opens the game menu of an upcoming one (reminder, record, channel); hold OK opens the game menu.
controls: Hold OK on a team in Standings or My Teams

title: Show / hide, favourite, send back
answer: OK shows or hides a league in the tab. Hold: Make favourite league (Sports Trak opens on it), Send back to the league bank. Add more leagues from the bank below.

title: Move the sound
answer: The speaker dot shows which screen you hear.

title: Screen menu
answer: Full screen, Reload, Change channel, Remove. In 1 + 3, a small screen also has Move to the big screen.

title: Header
answer: The layout switch and Multiview's other buttons. Android in landscape offers 2 screens, 4 screens, or 1 + 3: one big screen with three small ones. Windows keeps the 2- and 4-screen layouts. ↓ goes back to the screens.

title: Show the controls
answer: The first OK only brings back the name and back arrow. Back always works.

title: Recording menu
answer: While it records: Watch live, Play from the start, Stop recording (keeps it), Cancel recording.

title: Filter Group Management
answer: TV, Movies and TV Shows each have their own search. Type US to show groups starting with US; the list narrows with each letter. Show results / Hide results affects only those matches. Clear search restores every group. The keyboard's Search key moves to Show results, or Clear search if there are no matches.

title: In and out of a category
Type
answer: The keyboard only opens on OK, so the arrows can pass over a text box. On a Fire TV the on-screen keyboard keeps the Back key for itself; use its own close or Done key.

title: On / off, or remove
answer: Settings › Media Hub › Add-ons. In Media Hub sources, use the Enabled control inside a source card.
controls: OK / Hold OK on an add-on

title: Select, then open
answer: One click selects a poster or channel (and fills the banner), a second click opens it.

title: Hold menus
answer: Holding the mouse button opens the same menus as Hold OK.

title: Mute
answer: The volume slider sits in the player bar and is remembered.

title: Side panel
answer: Same as on a TV, when the player bar isn't selected.
